about_the_game:
On the shores of Penglai, the Isle of Immortals, twelve legendary guardians stand between you and immortality. Every fight is a puzzle. Every death a lesson.

TWELVE LEGENDS. TWELVE PUZZLES.

Every encounter is a boss battle drawn from the Shanhaijing, China's ancient bestiary of myths and monsters. Some guardians demand vertical traversal. Others require manipulating the arena itself. Every battle asks a different question. Positioning, timing, and observation are your greatest weapons

AN INK-PAINTED WORLD

Penglai comes to life through painterly ink-wash visuals inspired by traditional Chinese brush painting. Between battles, wander the island’s sacred spaces and ruins. The island's mysteries reveal themselves to those who look closely.

MASTER THE IMMORTALS

Victory is only the beginning. Boss variants introduce new mechanics and demand new strategies. Challenge Mode and global leaderboards reward precision and efficiency. What once felt impossible becomes repeatable. Mastery turns guardians into speedruns.

KEY FEATURES

  • 12 unique bosses drawn from the Shanhaijing — the Four Evils, the Dragon Kings, and the Gods of Mt. Kunlun.

  • Combat as puzzle: Every encounter demands observation, pattern recognition, and precise execution.

  • An island of secrets:  Explore the sacred Isle of Immortals, uncovering ruins, shrines, and echoes of ancient myth.

  • Ink wash art style: Every frame rendered as a living Chinese brush painting

  • Challenge Mode & Leaderboards: Boss variants, mastery runs, and global rankings for players who chase perfection.

12 legendary boss fights. Endless mastery.
